# INOVATIV

> > INOVATIV designs and manufactures professional mobile workstations, carts, and mounting systems for film production, digital imaging technicians (DITs), and camera operators.

Based in California, INOVATIV specializes in production gear including the Apollo, Voyager, Echo, and Deploy workstations, AXIS Stand systems, and comprehensive mounting solutions for on-set workflows. Their products serve camera operators, DITs, Steadicam operators, and grip departments with modular, professional-grade equipment.

## Key Topics

- Mobile Workstations
- AXIS Stand & WorkSurface Pro
- Apollo Workstation
- Voyager EVO X Workstation
- Echo Workstation
- Deploy Vertical Rack Cart
- Camera Mount Systems & Plates
- Monitor Mounting (QR, VESA, Insight)
- Film Production Gear
- Digital Imaging Technician (DIT) Equipment
- Steadicam Accessories
- Grip Cart Equipment
- Baby Pin System
- DigiSystem Tethering
- Modular Workstation Accessories
